description: Represents a relationship between a file and a business entity (e.g., invoice, message, appointment). This allows files to be attached to various entities across the platform. When a file has at least one active relation, its status becomes 'linked' and it is protected from cleanup jobs.

uid.description: Unique identifier for the file-entity relation record (e.g., "rel_123abc").

file_uid.description: Unique identifier of the file being linked (e.g., "file_456def"). Must reference an existing file with status 'scanned', 'uploaded', or 'linked'.

entity_type.description: Type of entity the file is attached to. **message**: Email message. **invoice**: Invoice document. **payment**: Payment record. **appointment**: Scheduled appointment. **estimate**: Estimate/quote document.

entity_uid.description: Unique identifier of the entity the file is attached to (e.g., "inv_789xyz" for an invoice, "msg_123abc" for a message).

business_uid.description: Unique identifier of the business that owns both the file and the entity (e.g., "biz_456xyz"). Inherited from the file record.

client_uid.description: Unique identifier of the client associated with this relation, if applicable (e.g., "client_789abc"). Used for client-specific files like uploaded documents or images. Null for business-level files.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the relation was created, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2026-01-27T10:35:00Z").

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the relation was last updated, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2026-01-27T10:35:30Z").

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the relation was soft deleted, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2026-01-27T12:00:00Z"). Null if the relation is still active. When all relations for a file are deleted, the file may become eligible for cleanup.

file.description: Details of the linked file, included when relations are fetched by entity. Omitted on relation creation.

status.description: Current processing status of the linked file.

content_type.description: MIME type of the linked file (e.g., "application/pdf", "image/jpeg").

url.description: Pre-signed S3 URL for downloading the original file. Null for pending/infected files.

thumbnail_url.description: Pre-signed S3 URL for the 400x400 pixel thumbnail. Null for non-image files or pending uploads.

thumbnail_small_url.description: Pre-signed S3 URL for the 150x150 pixel thumbnail. Null for non-image files or pending uploads.

metadata.description: Optional JSON object containing arbitrary key-value pairs for additional file metadata.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the file record was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the file record was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.
